title: Report Non-Emergency Problems in Unincorporated San Diego County with Tell Us Now! App
description:
Report non-emergency problems in San Diego County’s unincorporated areas with the Tell Us Now! app.
☑️Storm-related issues
☑️Air quality 
☑️Vector control
☑️Pricing and scale issues
☑️And more!
Download today on the App Store or Google Play.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To view this video in your preferred language, press settings, then subtitles, then auto-translate and pick your language when captions are made available by YouTube.
